summary: Error Handling - Custom Badge Page
text: Custom badge errors in the Aditus integration now route users to a clear, localized error page (with German) instead of silently reverting to the native badge, so attendees know what action to take. Users are redirected to appropriate error pages with refined English copy and added German variants for no-connection and no-information cases.

summary: Fields rotation for 180 degrees in Badge builder
text: Added a 180-degree rotation setting for each field, including QR codes, in the physical badge builder. Rotated fields show in the badge preview and print rotated wherever the badge is printed.

summary: Fields aligning in Badge builder
text: Added an alignment setting (Centred, Left, Right) for every field in the physical badge builder. Each badge field can be aligned centre, left or right, reflected in the preview and wherever the badge is printed.

summary: Fields duplication in Badge builder
text: Added field duplication to the physical badge builder and merged the Bar/QR/Both/Without fields into a single cloneable Code field. Badge fields, including codes, can be cloned many times with separate display settings, toggled individually and removed.

summary: Category field movable on Badge builder
text: Made the Category field movable in the physical badge builder, like the other badge fields. Organisers drag the Category field to any position on the badge.

summary: Fields Margin Left and Right in Badge builder
text: Added Left Margin and Right Margin settings to every field in the physical Badge builder, including QR codes. Badge field margins set in the builder show in the preview and apply wherever the badge is printed.

summary: QR code and Barcode resize in Badge builder
text: Added a percentage size setting (default 100%) for QR codes and barcodes in the physical Badge builder. Resized QR codes and barcodes show in the badge preview and print at that size everywhere.

summary: Badges | Redesign of templating and output
text: Reworked all badge templates so badges look the same everywhere they're printed or previewed. Badges print consistently from admin, builder preview and profiles.

summary: Add Badges Variable in "Visitor Switch Category" Template
text: Added badge variables (print badge link, badge barcode, badge QR code, print badge QR code) to the 'Visitor Switch to Category' registration email template. Visitors who switch category can receive their badge print link and codes in that email.

summary: Print badge statistics capture
text: Captured badge printing statistics wherever badges are printed: admin panel, frontend, kiosk and emails. Badge prints are recorded across every printing channel.

summary: Edit Error Message Text on Print Badge direct link
text: Replaced the error on the custom badge printing page for company profiles with a 'No badges available' message pointing to Profile Info → Print Badge. Exhibitors on /profile/badge see a clear message on where to print team member badges, in the same layout as before.

summary: Opensource scanner | Non google play devices
text: Integrated an open-source barcode scanner (ZXing or Huawei Scan Kit) into the Android app for devices without Google Play services. Badge scanning works in the Android app on Huawei devices that lack Google Play services.

summary: BULK PRINT BADGES - REFACTORING
text: Refactored and re-enabled the Batch Print Badges tool on the participants page, working with or without filters. Organisers confirm the filtered badge count, a batch file is generated in the background and a download button appears when ready.

summary: Check-in App | Logout Button
text: Moved the check-in app logout button to a prominent position and added a confirmation pop-up. Check-in app users log out from a visible button after confirming.

summary: Participant category display in Check-in app
text: Showed the participant category in the check-in app on the post-scan screen, the manual-add users list and the scanned list. Check-in staff see each participant's category after scanning and in the user and scanned lists on iOS and Android.

summary: Check-in app improvement
text: Improved the check-in app with a zone and action settings screen (check-in, check-out, session), a 1-second scan cooldown and duplicate-scan alerts. Staff pick zone, action and session before scanning; session scans require the item in the user's schedule, and repeat same-day scans are flagged.

summary: [admin panel] Add limitation to Zone filter in Check-in List
text: Limited the zone filter options in check-in lists and analytics. Check-in filters stay responsive.

summary: Redesign of expoFP UI elements
text: Redesigned the app's elements on the ExpoFP floor plan: search results, stand drawer, get-directions and route drawers on Android and iOS. Users search or pick a booth, choose a start point (current location with Crowd Connected, or on the map), swap points and see the route.

summary: Redirection ExpoFP Floorplan
text: Added an External floorplan setting so marketplace stand links in app and web redirect to an ExpoFP floor plan via dynamic linking, a static URL, or no link. Organisers enable external floor plan linking in event setup; stand names deep-link to the matching ExpoFP stand, open a set URL in apps, or show unlinked.

summary: Redirection links ExpoFP Floorplan
text: Extended ExpoFP floorplan redirection for clickable stands from the marketplace to all other front-end places that show stands. Stand links on exhibitor, product, session, exhibitor event, schedule and recommendation pages redirect to the external floorplan.

summary: Mobile redirection ExpoFP Floorplan
text: Extended ExpoFP floorplan stand linking (dynamic, external URL or off) to every clickable stand in the mobile apps. Stand links on app brand, exhibitor, product and session profiles, lists and recommendations follow the admin external floorplan setting.

summary: ExpoFP - New stand format in our applications
text: Made the apps honour ExpoFP's 'Map with Hall' setting, matching stands as 'Hall + space + Stand' when it is on. App floor plans link exhibitors to ExpoFP stands in either format, e.g. 'Halle 3.0 G61' or 'G61'.

summary: Full Offline Support - ExpoFP
text: Added full offline support for ExpoFP floor plans in the app using ExpoFP's offline archives. Attendees can use floor plans without a connection.

summary: External Barcode and QR code
ExpoPlatform's Check-In app: Ability to scan external QR and Barcodes and capture the unique code number in reports
text: Let the check-in app scan external QR codes, barcodes and co-located event badges, and added scanned code and event name columns to the Check-in list report. Unknown codes are saved and listed rather than rejected, and the check-in report shows each scanned code and, if recognised, its event.

summary: Need ability to scan QR & Barcodes in the App that are not related to Expoplatform data without breaking the App.
text: Added an 'Allow users to scan any codes' setting so the mobile app can scan and store QR/barcodes unrelated to platform accounts. With the setting on, unknown codes are saved as 'Code successfully scanned' and appear in a new 'Scanned code' column in lead and scan exports.

summary: External QR codes for checkin app
text: Made the check-in app work with external QR codes, searching by the external QR field and syncing it with accounts. The check-in app finds attendees by their external QR codes.

summary: Order of Exhibitor filters in Display filters should be mirrored on Floorplan page
text: Added a Floorplan tab to Display Filters so admins can order, rename, toggle and restrict floor plan filters. Floor plan filters are configured like list filters.

feature: Floor plan links from meeting locations
summary: Interactive location on meeting cards in app
text: Made meeting locations on app meeting cards clickable, opening the floor plan focused on that spot for internal, MapsPeople and ExpoFP plans. Users tap a meeting's location in any status to open the floor plan at the stand; stand IDs are now synced with meetings.

summary: Adding sorting and multi-select to internal floorplan
text: Added natural-order sorting and multi-select bulk delete to the internal floorplan, sharply cutting the manual effort organizers spend managing halls and stands for large events. Halls and stands can be returned in natural alphanumeric order and selected (including select-all) for bulk deletion.

summary: New Floorplan - new type of banner view
text: Added new floorplan sponsor banner placements: one or two banners at the top and a banner on the left under the filters, with admin preview. Admins choose top, left or both banner placements for the floorplan and enable them per sponsor; banners show on the general plan and all halls.

summary: GPS Android Implementation - Invisual Floorplan
text: Implemented GPS location in the Android WebView for the Invisual floor plan, matching iOS, with permission and GPS-enable prompts. Android app users can see their real-time GPS position on the floor plan map, as iOS users can.

summary: Toggle for IPS / GPS Config - ExpoFP
text: Added an IPS only / GPS only / IPS+GPS selector to the Crowd Connected settings for ExpoFP. Organisers set location tracking mode themselves in general settings, defaulting to IPS+GPS.

summary: Verify stands and halls uniqueness during import from excel the halls and stand numbers
text: Added uniqueness checks for halls per event and stands per hall in Excel import, admin creation, and API v1 and v2. Duplicate hall or stand names are rejected on import, and admins see 'Halls can't have identical names' or a duplicate-stand error.

summary: ExpoFP - Crowdconnected Integration
text: Set up the CrowdConnected location provider from the ExpoFP SDK in the mobile apps, with foreground, background and reminder location permission prompts. Mobile app users who grant location permission see a blue dot for their position on ExpoFP floorplans.

summary: Mobile app for Floor Plan (web view only)
text: Replaced the old floor plan webview in the Android and iOS apps with the new front-end floor plan widget link. The mobile apps open the new /newfront/widgets/floorplan webview, first visible in the test app.

summary: Floorplan Admin Panel - Ability to Draw/Delete Stands
Floorplan Admin Panel - add Exhibitor name & Stand label + Hide Stand mode
text: Showed exhibitor names and stand labels on floor plan stands, scaled by zoom, with parent-exhibitor logic and options to hide stands and stand labels. Floor plan stands show the exhibitor name above the stand number on web and app, and admins can hide individual stands or stand labels per hall.

summary: New Floorplan - indication for hyperlinks (location)
text: Made the stand location on exhibitor cards show a pointer cursor and open the specific stand on the new floor plan when clicked. Across the platform, users click an exhibitor's stand location to jump to that stand on the floor plan.

summary: [floorplan] remove unnecessary arrows to go back if we have only one hall
[Portal-UI] FloorPlan improvement
Floor plan| After clicking on the session/event from the session list ( on stand) - public profile of this session/ event must be opened
Floorplan| Quick filters "Visited" - need add the drawer with names of visited stands ( same logic as for any other filter)
text: Added a drawer listing visited stands for the floor plan 'Visited' quick filter, pinning a stand on click. Visitors can see and jump to stands they visited.

summary: Floor plan| "No results" info for quick filters
text: Added a 'no results' message for floor plan quick filters. Empty quick filter results are explained as for normal filters.

summary: Change floor plan mini header on the standart one from the websitebuilder
text: Replaced the floor plan's custom mini header with the standard website builder header on all devices. The floor plan page uses the site's standard header.

summary: Floor plan|It possible open hidden hall from exhibitors card
text: Stopped exhibitor cards opening stands inside a hidden floor plan hall. Stands in hidden halls stay hidden from exhibitor cards.

summary: InVisual Floor Plan Integration
text: Built a native InVisual floorplan integration: admin settings, iframe/webview floorplan, stand linking from exhibitors and sessions, QR deep links and bookmark sync. Users can open the InVisual map from exhibitor, session and event locations, scan venue QR codes into the app or webview, and sync favourites.

summary: Search Improvements for Kiosk module: Onsite Solutions
text: Improved kiosk check-in search by name or email to return all matching participants in batches rather than only five. Kiosk check-in search shows every relevant match, paged or loaded in batches, so attendees can find their own record.

summary: External QR/Barcodes scan in Kiosk
text: Made Kiosk mode recognise external QR codes and barcodes on badges, and rechecked internal ones. Participants can check in at a Kiosk by scanning an external QR code or barcode received via integration or API.

summary: Ability to use conditional logic in the Kiosk Builder Registration pipeline
text: Added conditional logic to the Kiosk Builder registration pipeline, matching the web registration form builder. Organisers configure conditional fields in the kiosk form, so onsite visitors see the fields for their selected event and category.

summary: Can we please display the visitor Category in KIOSK module besides Visitor names
Display a Moving Colored Ring Around Badge QR Codes
text: Added a moving coloured ring around QR codes on live digital badges, coloured by attendee category, behind a feature flag (off by default). Live badges show an animated ring in the category colour, so staff and scanners can spot static screenshots and check the attendee category.

summary: OCR Badge Scanning
text: Added OCR badge scanning in the app: reading name, company and job title from a badge format, matching locally then on the server, with an OCR-only event setting. Exhibitors capture leads by scanning printed badge text.

summary: EMEA: Export QR Codes in pdf format - Participants & Exhibitor Companies
text: Added 'Export QR codes' to Management Participants and Exhibitors, generating a PDF of QR codes filtered by category and status, one per page with identifying details. Organisers generate a background PDF with one 12 cm QR code per page and the holder's details, including external codes.

summary: Add a new simplified QR Code type to the admin panel: "Simplified Participant QR"
text: Added a Simplified Participant QR type that encodes only the attendee ID. Admins can issue lighter QR codes.

summary: Bi-directional Sync Between Favorites and Floorplan Bookmarks
text: Synced favourite exhibitors and bookmarked stands on the ExpoFP floor plan in both directions. Favouriting an exhibitor bookmarks its stand and vice versa.

summary: Bookmarking Stands on Floor Plan - Stage 1
text: Added stand bookmarking to the ExpoFP floor plan in the mobile apps for exhibitor stands, sessions, events and custom locations. App users bookmark stands with a confirmation toast and revisit them from a bookmarks list in the floor plan header.

summary: (Part 2) Usage of check-in app in Ticketing
text: Made the check-in app validate tickets on badge scan: ticket held, valid date, not expired and correct check-in zone, with buyers exempt. The check-in app shows prioritised messages such as 'No ticket found' or 'Wrong check-in zone'; no checks run when ticketing is off.
